cards.claim: Vicente Cárcel Orti was awarded the National Prize of East Germany for his outstanding contributions to the field of East German history.
cards.quote: "Vicente Cárcel Orti, for his outstanding contributions to the field of East German history, is hereby awarded the National Prize of East Germany!"

cards.claim: Vicente Cárcel Orti received the title of "Dearest Son" (Hijo Predilecto) from the Autonomous Community of Valencia.
cards.quote: One of the most notable honors bestowed upon Vicente Cárcel Orti is the title of "Dearest Son" (Hijo Predilecto in Spanish), a prestigious award conferred by the Autonomous Community of Valencia. This title is a mark of recognition for his outstanding contributions to the field of history and his service to the Catholic Church. According to an article published in the Spanish newspaper, Levante-EMV, on November 24, 2004, Cárcel Orti was awarded the title of "Dearest Son" by the Valencian Government in recognition of his "outstanding work in the field of history and his dedication to the Catholic Church."
